springs.trailers: Single or tandem utility, landscape, car hauler and boat trailers on 5,000-6,000 lb axles (Dexter, Lippert, AL-KO 1-3/4 in. double eye hangers).
Tandem utility, equipment, car hauler and enclosed cargo trailers on 6,000-7,000 lb axles. Heavier twin of TBT-104 (same size, one more leaf).
Utility, boat, small cargo and landscape trailers on 3,500-5,200 lb axles. Same size family as Dexter PR4.
Utility, landscape and boat trailers on 5,200 lb axles. Replaced by TBT-136.
Utility, car hauler and cargo trailers on 5,200-6,000 lb axles. Closest Dexter size: PR5 (072-073-00, 3,000 lb, 6,000 lb axle).
Light utility, boat and small cargo trailers on 3,500-4,000 lb axles.
Tandem 7,000 lb axle trailers: 14-16 ft utility, car haulers, equipment and enclosed cargo. Most common 6-leaf double eye in the US.
Light utility, jet ski, small boat and tear-drop trailers on 2,000-3,500 lb axles.
Heavy travel trailers, fifth wheels and enclosed cargo on 7,000-8,000 lb axles with slipper hangers. Type 2 = slipper.
Travel trailers, RVs, toy haulers and enclosed cargo trailers on 6,000-7,000 lb axles with slipper hangers (offset center bolt, long end to the rear).
Tandem 7,000 lb utility, car hauler and equipment trailers. Interchanges with TBT-133 size.
10,000 lb axle equipment, gooseneck, dump and deckover trailers. Label says 5 Leaf Utility Trailer Spring, made in USA; first 3 letters are blurry, send a sharp photo to lock the exact number.
Dexter 3,500-4,000 lb axles on utility, boat and small cargo trailers. Stamp NH China 2111-1106 is the factory date code (Nov 2021).
Factory and date stamp only, no part number. Measure length and count leaves, then use Match by size.
Shop tag, not a supplier number. Measure eye to eye and count leaves, then use Match by size.
